nodes.description: Mapping address => Holder storing user balances and unlock times; mutated by Put and Collect.
Log contract instance used by Put and Collect to record messages.
Minimum balance threshold (1 ether) required before Collect succeeds.
Payable deposit function that credits msg.value to the caller's Holder entry and sets unlockTime.
Payable withdraw function that checks balance, MinSum and unlockTime then sends ether via call.value.
Default payable function that forwards to Put(0).
Constructor that stores the Log contract address in LogFile.
Caller-controlled address used as the key into the Acc mapping in Put.
Caller-controlled address used to look up the Holder entry and as the external call target in Collect.
Block timestamp (now) used to bound the unlockTime supplied by the caller in Put.
Block timestamp (now) compared against acc.unlockTime in Collect.
msg.sender.call.value(_am)() external call performed before the balance is decremented (reentrancy).
Caller-supplied unlock time parameter of Put.
Caller-supplied withdrawal amount parameter of Collect.
Log contract address passed to the constructor.
Storage reference to Acc[msg.sender] inside Put.
Storage reference to Acc[msg.sender] inside Collect.
Array of Message structs that stores all logged messages.
Scratch Message struct written before being pushed to History.
Public logging function that writes a Message and pushes it to History.
Block timestamp (now) recorded in LastMsg.Time.
Sender address parameter of AddMessage.
Value parameter of AddMessage.
Data string parameter of AddMessage.

edges.reason: The fallback function forwards execution to Put(0), making deposits reachable with no data.
msg.sender is used as the index into Acc to obtain the acc storage reference in Put.
now is compared with _unlockTime and written into acc.unlockTime (timestamp dependency).
The _unlockTime parameter is stored into acc.unlockTime.
Put writes the updated balance and unlockTime back into the Acc mapping.
msg.sender indexes Acc to obtain the acc storage reference in Collect.
now is compared against acc.unlockTime in the Collect guard condition (timestamp dependency).
The _am parameter is used as the value of the external call, allowing arbitrary withdrawal amount.
Collect performs the external call before updating internal state.
acc.balance is decremented only after the external call returns, enabling reentrant withdrawals.
acc.balance and unlockTime from storage are read to authorize the external call.
MinSum is read in the Collect guard condition.
The Acc mapping is read by Collect to check the caller's balance and unlockTime.
Collect calls LogFile.AddMessage to record the withdrawal.
Put calls LogFile.AddMessage to record the deposit.
The LogFile state variable targets the Log contract's AddMessage function.
The constructor parameter log is assigned to the LogFile state variable.
The constructor writes the provided Log address into LogFile.
_adr is stored into LastMsg.Sender.
_val is stored into LastMsg.Val.
_data is stored into LastMsg.Data.
now is stored into LastMsg.Time (timestamp dependency).
LastMsg is pushed into the History array.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter exists only to be written into acc.unlockTime inside Put and has no independent security meaning.
_am is consumed directly as the value of the unsafe external call in Collect.
The constructor argument is immediately assigned to LogFile and has no other use.
acc is a temporary storage reference created and consumed entirely within Put.
acc is the storage entry whose balance is read before and updated after the unsafe external call.
The address argument is only written into LastMsg.Sender within AddMessage.
The value argument is only written into LastMsg.Val within AddMessage.
The data argument is only written into LastMsg.Data within AddMessage.
